parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must function as a digital office, ensuring that the receipt of appeals, hearings, and decision pronouncement are conducted digitally.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Appellate Tribunal's processes for handling appeals are designed to be digital.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all appeals filed under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement focuses on the digital transformation of the Appellate Tribunal's operations.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must dispose of appeals finally within six months from the date of receipt.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal has a policy to resolve appeals within six months.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all appeals filed under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement sets a time limit for the resolution of appeals.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must ensure that the acceptance of a voluntary undertaking by the Board bars proceedings under the Act regarding the contents of the undertaking, except in cases covered by sub-section (5).
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the acceptance of a voluntary undertaking by the Board prevents further proceedings under the Act, except in specified cases.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to voluntary undertakings accepted by the Board under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the effect of accepting a voluntary undertaking by the Board.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board must consider the nature, gravity, and duration of the breach when determining the amount of monetary penalty.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Board's penalty determination includes consideration of the nature, gravity, and duration of the breach.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all breaches subject to monetary penalties under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines a factor to be considered in determining penalties for breaches.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board must consider the repetitive nature of the breach when determining the amount of monetary penalty.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Board's penalty determination includes consideration of the repetitive nature of the breach.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all breaches subject to monetary penalties under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines a factor to be considered in determining penalties for breaches.
